title: 第十章 好好照顾嫂子！
content_zh:
院子里，王大壮光着膀子，只穿了一条宽松的长裤，正赤脚站在泥地上。

    晨光洒在他宽阔的肩背上，那古铜色的皮肤上还挂着细密的汗珠，随着他每一个动作的起伏，肌肉线条在光影下呈现出一种近乎完美的轮廓。

    宽肩窄腰，脊背挺直，每一块肌肉都像是被精心雕琢过一般，既有爆发力又不失协调感。

    李玉梅的目光从他宽阔的背部滑到紧实的腰腹，再移到那两条笔直有力的长腿，心跳骤然加速，脸颊不受控制地烧了起来。

    她不由得想入非非起来，心里暗骂自己不争气。

    这傻小子，怎么一大早就在院子里光着膀子，也不怕着凉？

    不对，重点是——他什么时候变得这么……这么……

    李玉梅深吸一口气，努力让自己的目光保持镇定，可眼角余光还是忍不住又瞟了过去。

    王大壮的动作流畅而有力，出拳时带着呼呼风声，收招时又行云流水毫无凝滞。

    他忽然双腿微屈，腰胯下沉，双掌自胸前缓缓推出，整个人仿佛与周围的空气融为一体，那种浑然天成的气势，根本不像是一个刚恢复神智的人，反倒像是练了多年的武道高手。

    李玉梅看得入神，竟忘了挪开目光。

    一套拳打完，王大壮缓缓收势，双手自胸前下压，轻轻吐出一口浊气。

    那口气息在清晨的冷空气中凝成一道淡淡的白线，笔直地射出三尺多远才缓缓消散。

    他睁开眼，整个人神清气爽，只觉得浑身上下每一个毛孔都透着舒泰。

    仙武传承里的这套基础拳法，果然不一般。

    昨晚只是在脑海中过了一遍，今早试着打出来，那股微弱灵气竟然随着招式的运转在体内自行流转，滋养着筋骨皮肉，甚至连精神都格外清明。

    李玉梅被王大壮看得心跳又漏了一拍，连忙垂下眼帘，慌乱道：“你……也不多穿点，大清早的寒气重，别冻着了。”

    王大壮低头看了看自己光着的上身，倒是毫不在意地笑了笑道：“没事的嫂子，我身体结实着呢，不冷。”

    李玉梅没接话，她赶紧转过身往屋里走，边走边说道：“我去做早饭，吃完咱们就上山。”

    “好。”王大壮应了一声，弯腰捡起搭在院墙上的旧衬衫套上。

    李玉梅走进灶房，蹲在灶台前点火烧水，灶膛里的火光映在她脸上，把那层红晕照得更加明显。
content_en:
In the yard, Wang Dazhuang was shirtless, wearing only a pair of loose trousers, and was standing barefoot on the dirt.

    The morning light shone on his broad shoulders and back, and there were fine beads of sweat hanging on his bronze skin. With every rise and fall of his movements, the muscle lines showed an almost perfect outline under the light and shadow.

    With wide shoulders and narrow waist, a straight back, every muscle seems to have been carefully sculpted, giving it explosive power without losing coordination.

    Li Youmei's eyes slid from his broad back to his tight waist and abdomen, and then to the two straight and powerful long legs. Her heartbeat suddenly accelerated and her cheeks burned uncontrollably.

    She couldn't help but have wild thoughts, and secretly cursed herself for not living up to expectations.

    How come this silly boy is not afraid of catching a cold even though he is shirtless in the yard so early in the morning?

    No, the point is - when did he become so... so...

    Li Youmei took a deep breath and tried to keep her eyes calm, but she couldn't help but glance over again from the corner of her eyes.

    Wang Dazhuang's movements are smooth and powerful. There is a whistling sound when punching out, and when he withdraws his moves, he is smooth and smooth without any stagnation.

    Suddenly, his legs slightly bent, his waist and hips dropped, and his palms slowly pushed out from his chest. His whole body seemed to be integrated with the surrounding air. His natural aura did not look like a person who had just regained consciousness, but rather like a martial arts master who had been practicing for many years.

    Li Youmei was so entranced that she forgot to look away.

    After finishing a set of punches, Wang Dazhuang slowly stopped his punches, pressed his hands down from his chest, and let out a breath of dirty air.

    The breath condensed into a faint white line in the cold morning air, shooting straight for more than three feet before slowly dissipating.

    He opened his eyes, feeling refreshed and comfortable in every pore in his body.

    This set of basic boxing techniques in the Xianwu inheritance is indeed extraordinary.

    I just went through it in my mind last night, and tried to type it out this morning. The weak spiritual energy actually circulated in the body along with the movement, nourishing the muscles, bones, skin, and even the spirit.

    Li Youmei's heart skipped a beat when Wang Dazhuang saw her. She quickly lowered her eyes and said in a panic: "You... don't wear more clothes. It's very cold in the early morning, so don't freeze."

    Wang Dazhuang looked down at his bare upper body, smiled nonchalantly and said, "It's okay, sister-in-law, I'm strong and not cold."

    Li Youmei didn't answer. She quickly turned around and walked into the house. As she walked, she said, "I'm going to make breakfast. After that, we'll go up the mountain."

    "Okay." Wang Dazhuang responded, bent down to pick up the old shirt hanging on the courtyard wall and put it on.

    Li Youmei walked into the kitchen and squatted in front of the stove to light a fire and boil water. The firelight in the stove reflected on her face, making the blush more obvious.
title_en: Chapter 10 Take good care of your sister-in-law!
